row.notes: Builds the settings filter/category tile list: sets self+0x8b0 = !DAT_14606c9dc, stores listModel at self+0xa98, then walks the self+0x870 categories (pointers at self+0x670) in rows of 3. Each row is a 0x130-byte tile, each category a 0x210-byte tile with VM props name, title, description, icon_tex, icon_visible, highlight, new_filter; title text is picked by comparing the category id string against fixed ids, description comes from the localisation key suffix _description (or _description_f1w for one id when func_0x00014254fc10 is true). Tiles are pushed into the vector at listModel+0x50/+0x58/+0x60 and it ends with Game_SettingsTabbingBaseViewModel_WorkoutCategoriesAction(self, listModel+0x48). Hook here to add or hide settings categories.
